arguments.summary: Incident investigation revealed a multi-stage attack originating from a compromised workstation (WS-FIN-042) used by user CORP\jsmith. The threat actor executed a suspicious rundll32 process, established C2 communication via Cobalt Strike beaconing to 198.51.100.23, and attempted lateral movement via SMB. Containment actions included password and MFA reset for the affected user and a full EPP scan that detected 'Dropper.Linux.Agent.F' on the host. An initial firewall block on 185.220.101.42 was attempted but not consensus-approved; however, replay confirmed prior successful block. No further containment actions (e.g., host isolation) were approved.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Traffic
id: 5a7b8c9d-e0f1-2345-6789-0abcdef12345
description: Detects regular HTTPS beaconing to a C2 server with low jitter, characteristic of Cobalt Strike.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/
    - https://www.fireeye.com/blog/threat-research/2013/04/cobalt-strike-threat-utility.html
logsource:
    category: network_connection
    product: firewall
    service: netflow
    definition: 'Connection logs with duration and byte count'
detection:
    selection:
        protocol: 'tcp'
